messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: p99 latency 1325ms (SLO: 800ms) observed on /v1/generate across us-east-1 cluster over last 5m. Threshold breached: 3 consecutive 1m windows.

pagerduty: PagerDuty incident fired: PD-INC-4551 -> paged oncall: @josh, priority: P1. Link: https://pagerduty.example/PD-INC-4551

josh: Acked. I'm on it. Pulling up dashboards.

josh: Graphs: https://grafana.internal/dashboard/db/latency?panelId=12&from=now-15m to now

josh: p95 ~ 420ms, p99 ~ 1325ms. Error rate stable. CPU/GPU utilization in the green, but KV-cache hit rate dropped to 10% (normal ~55%). Suspect KV cache thrash.

raj: copying runbook steps for kv-cache thrash -> /runbooks/kvcache-thrash

runbook-bot: Runbook: kvcache-thrash
1) Check Redis/TLS metrics
2) Restart cache-workers one at a time
3) Rollback recent cache rollouts
4) Enable prefix caching fallback

josh: running quick check: `redis-cli -h redis-main info | grep evicted_keys` shows evicted_keys: 12345

marta: @josh if kv cache is evicting that hard maybe a bad config pushed earlier. Any recent config rollouts? @raj can you confirm?

raj: there was a cache config rollout 09:02 UTC, changed key TTLs and sharding. I rolled it back to previous at 09:12 but controller didn't converge for a replica.

josh: I'm going to enable fallback routing to serve from model-small-1 for tail requests to reduce latency.

josh: patching router: 
```sh
kubectl -n inference scale deploy router-canary --replicas=2
kubectl -n inference apply -f - <<'YAML'
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: routing-fallback
data:
  fallback_policy: "prefer:model-small-1@10%"
YAML
```

incident-bot: Action recorded: fallback_policy applied by josh at 09:28 UTC.

pagerduty: Note added to PD-INC-4551 by josh: enabled fallback routing, investigating kv-cache evictions.

marta: Good. Monitor p99 and error rate. If p99 < 900ms after 5m, we can start de-escalation.

josh: After fallback: p99 dropped to 760ms in 2m, p95 to 350ms. KV-cache evictions still high; engineers on cache team are looking.

sre-rotation: I'm taking over rotation for oncall handoff at 09:45 UTC. @marta please confirm any outstanding action items.

marta: Handoff: fallback routing active, cache rollback partially converged, need full cache replica resync and confirm no config memleak. Customer impact: intermittent higher latency for a subset of live traffic until fallback => degraded but functional.

sre-rotation: Ack. I'll coordinate with cache-team for resync. Paging senior-cache-engineer if not converged in 15m.

pagerduty: Escalation scheduled at 09:58 UTC if problem persists. PD-INC-4551 current status: acknowledged.

raj: Started resync: `kubectl -n cache rollout restart statefulset/cache` on replica-2. Watching evicted_keys.

josh: Noting potential root cause: mis-sharded cache keys + TTL change, leading to evictions and heavier backend load -> longer model hot-starts at tail.

runbook-bot: Suggested mitigations applied: fallback routing, partial rollback. Next steps: full resync, postmortem template created: https://docs.internal/incidents/PD-INC-4551/postmortem

marta: If p99 remains < 900ms for 10 consecutive minutes let's close the page and file postmortem.

sre-rotation: p99 stabilized ~ 700-820ms for the last 10m. Marking incident as mitigated at 10:05 UTC. Will wait 15m before close.

pagerduty: PD-INC-4551 status update: mitigated -> waiting for closure. Close notes: fallback routing applied; cache resync in progress. 

marta: Thanks everyone. Follow-up: schedule root cause RCA with cache and infra teams, include timeline and config diff from 09:02 rollout. Assign owners in the postmortem.

sre-rotation: Copy. Closing comments will be appended to PD. Closing thread in 15m if no regression. :white_check_mark:
